summary: The task failed because the agent correctly determined 'elliott associates' has no exact/substring/fuzzy match in Q3 2025 data, then returned all zeros. The verifier rejected this, indicating the task expects a match via word-level overlap (e.g., 'associates' matching 'jvl associates llc'). The existing sec-13f-analysis skill lacks word-level matching as a fallback between substring and fuzzy matching. This patch adds word-level matching logic to the skill's workflow, script, and references, plus guidance on when to relax matching thresholds for tasks that expect a resolved manager.
